method: Complete declarations and procedures; exact source relocation with CP287 canonical crosswalk, historical B09-71–78 dispositions (normalize singular/plural category labels; match kind,id,span,operation), current new CP292 sites. Historical interpretations are evidence only; current contracts govern changed context. No full current AST replay.

groups.title: Range record
groups.meaning: Mutable slotted dataclass with no defaults, separate S candidates/accepted S, retained references not deep copies.

groups.title: Visibility record
groups.meaning: Mutable slots; separate public lists, audit and projection parent lists. primary_groups fresh dict per instance keyword-only; projection no independent legacy rows or lifecycle feedback.

groups.title: Range prerequisites
groups.meaning: Direct requested result index, native opposite direction, market bounds. Blue prerequisite OR of exact enabled Blue/A/S flags, even if Blue display disabled.

groups.title: Blue selection
groups.meaning: Reusable required: new shallow list inclusive int(source_index) range. Otherwise required native full reactions/resets/chronology timed, no local clipping. Else empty.

groups.title: A selection
groups.meaning: A or S enabled requires A. Reusable clips full A by inclusive int source index; otherwise native A consumes selected Blue/full reactions/chronology with no local clipping; else empty.

groups.title: Reusable S
groups.meaning: Two separate empty lists initially. S enabled reusable retrieves full candidates and accepted S by reference, overrides clipped A with full eligible A reference.

groups.title: Fallback S
groups.meaning: Native S constructor uses both reaction directions, selected Blue/A, chronology, full 0..len(candles)-1, opposite resets and geometry callback. Timed detect, publish detector before eligible A read; accepted S aliases candidates. No catch.

groups.title: Range return
groups.meaning: Return current Blue/A/S references, shallow full E copy or empty; invalid sets map values or fresh empty sets. No serialization.

groups.title: Initial A visibility
groups.meaning: Native A removes occupied accepted S source indexes, then A whose candle contains S decision event; full candles supplied.

groups.title: Converged E/StopAll
groups.meaning: Shallow E and retained StopAll map copy (empty tuple default). Non-null E detector: deferred parent_stop callback S if a_source_time attribute exists else E. Otherwise deferred S.first_a_stop Decimal(str(getattr(item,price))) and decision_event_time. No local enable gate, root restore, StopAll rerun, rediscovery or registration. Non-null test differs from later E-key gate.

groups.title: Projection snapshot
groups.meaning: Three shallow lists before final visibility and range/internal filtering; item references retained, not deep immutable copies. Historical parent joins only.

groups.title: Native lineage closure
groups.meaning: Timed finalize_behavior_visibility initial A, full candidates, E/StopAll, direction, invalid S, stop callback and recorded source index/price/time candidate callback, full candles/all A. Native filters occupied source indexes, restores referenced historical S/A parents, sorts chronology, removes invalid S; returns E,S,A. No local catch.

groups.title: Primary groups
groups.meaning: After native closure before range/internal filtering: all A minus exact invalid A pairs; shallow S/E/StopAll current results. Distinct from projection and displayed arrays.

groups.title: Inclusive range
groups.meaning: Separate S,A,E,StopAll comprehensions use inclusive int source index, preserve order, no price math.

groups.title: Invalid A/S
groups.meaning: Exclude exact (source_time,int source_index) invalid pairs on clipped A and S only.

groups.title: Full audit provenance
groups.meaning: Collect source times from entire stored S detector eligible A excluding exact invalid A pairs; no range clipping. Direct S detector key access even if E absent.

groups.title: Internal Blue/behavior dispatch
groups.meaning: Flatten result map then reaction order. Native marks Blue item flags. Native filter_internal_behavior_outputs discards three reaction-context args and returns shallow lists; no secondary-Order filtering.

groups.title: Required audit IDs
groups.meaning: Post-handoff displayed S/E/StopAll only; both First/Break non-null, int conversions, native identity, set dedup.

groups.title: Audit preparation and validation
groups.meaning: E map key gate, not non-null test: prepare native audit with range, optional S detector, full eligible A sources and required IDs; else empty. Same key gate validates bridge consistency.

groups.title: Visibility return
groups.meaning: Native public Blue filters calculation-valid/noninternal; return displayed arrays, audit, projection snapshots and pre-range primary groups. No serialization or primary computation.
